body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2008') -- <Visual News> Samsung Electronics showcased its second generation premium touchscreen phone 'Anycall Haptic 2' during KES 2008, which adopts an upgraded UI and 50 widgets. In addition, users can change the UI according to their personal tastes with the on-handset graphic user interfaces, and create their own menu on the desktop through widgets. The Anycall Haptic 2 features a 5M camera functionality with hand-shake detection, auto focus, timer setting, 12 shooting modes and more. Coming in 4GB/16GB capabilities, it also supports 8GB of external memory. Other features included a 3.2-inch 16:9 display, Internet full browsing, T-DMB, Bluetooth 2.0 and more. The Anycall Haptic 2 will be available in Korea market from this Saturday, and suggested price is below 800,000(KRW) for 4GB and below 900,000(KRW) for 16GB.
